topics.title: Ligand-displaying LNPs for extrahepatic targeting: avidity vs specificity
topics.hypothesis: Multivalent display of low-affinity targeting ligands (e.g., mannose, transferrin, or anti-CD3 scFv) on LNP surfaces achieves higher tissue selectivity than high-affinity monovalent targeting, due to reduced off-target uptake by liver macrophages.
proposed_experiments: Synthesize LNPs with controlled densities of selected ligands (0–100% surface coverage)
Quantify uptake in target vs off-target cells with flow cytometry
Test in vivo biodistribution with reporter mRNAs in xenograft or disease models
topics.expected_readout: Target-to-liver uptake ratio; ≥5× improvement over non-targeted LNPs.
topics.feasibility_notes: Lipid-PEG-ligand chemistry is standard; main risk is synthesis scale-up.
topics.impact_rationale: Addresses 3 scored gaps in 'targeting' (cluster mean overall=0.66). Success would advance therapeutically relevant nucleic acid delivery.

topics.title: Decoupling innate immune activation from LNP delivery potency
topics.hypothesis: Ionizable lipid structure independently drives TLR/inflammasome activation versus endosomal escape; lipids can be optimized for high delivery with low reactogenicity.
proposed_experiments: Screen ionizable lipids for IL-6/IFN reporter activation in vitro
Correlate innate activation with endosomal escape efficiency
Validate low-inflammation high-potency candidates in mice
topics.expected_readout: ≥2× potency/inflammation ratio vs SM-102 or MC3 reference LNPs.
topics.feasibility_notes: Cell reporter assays are accessible; in vivo cytokine panels standard.
topics.impact_rationale: Addresses 3 scored gaps in 'immunogenicity' (cluster mean overall=0.65). Success would advance therapeutically relevant nucleic acid delivery.

topics.title: Mechanistic understanding of LNP endosomal escape: fusion vs destabilization
topics.hypothesis: Endosomal escape of LNPs proceeds primarily through membrane destabilization (ionizable lipid-facilitated flip-flop and bilayer disruption) rather than fusogenic mechanisms, and can be enhanced by helper lipids that lower the lamellar-to-hexagonal phase transition temperature.
proposed_experiments: Labelled lipid mixing vs content release assays to distinguish fusion from destabilization
Cryo-ET of LNPs in endosomal compartments at timed intervals after uptake
Vary helper lipid ratios and correlate with endosomal escape efficiency via FRET
topics.expected_readout: Quantitative fraction of delivered cargo reaching cytosol vs lysosomal degradation.
topics.feasibility_notes: Requires advanced microscopy (cryo-ET) — moderate; FRET assays are accessible.
topics.impact_rationale: Addresses 3 scored gaps in 'endosomal_escape' (cluster mean overall=0.65). Success would advance therapeutically relevant nucleic acid delivery.

topics.title: Quantitative bottleneck analysis of the LNP delivery cascade
topics.hypothesis: Endosomal escape—not uptake or encapsulation—is the dominant loss term in the delivery cascade for most clinical-like LNP compositions, and 10× escape gains are necessary and sufficient for transformative dose reduction.
proposed_experiments: Build a quantitative cascade map (injection→uptake→escape→translation) with barcoded mRNA
Perturb each step independently and measure sensitivity of protein output
Identify the step with highest elasticity for dose reduction
topics.expected_readout: Ranked elasticities per cascade step; validated 5× dose reduction via top lever.
topics.feasibility_notes: Requires careful assay development; high scientific payoff.
topics.impact_rationale: Addresses 3 scored gaps in 'delivery_efficiency' (cluster mean overall=0.64). Success would advance therapeutically relevant nucleic acid delivery.

topics.title: Rational design of ionizable lipids for extrahepatic nucleic acid delivery
topics.hypothesis: Systematic variation of ionizable lipid headgroup and tail architecture can achieve tissue-specific LNP tropism beyond the liver, enabling extravascular mRNA and siRNA delivery.
proposed_experiments: Synthesize a focused library of 20–30 ionizable lipids varying pKa and tail unsaturation
Screen LNPs for in vitro transfection across hepatocyte, endothelial, and immune cell lines
Validate top 5 candidates in vivo via IV administration with luminescent reporter mRNA
Quantify biodistribution by organ-specific luciferase expression and RT-qPCR
topics.expected_readout: Ratio of extrahepatic-to-liver protein expression; top candidate achieves ≥2× extrahepatic selectivity.
topics.feasibility_notes: Requires medicinal chemistry expertise (2–3 months for lipid library) and a small-animal facility.
topics.impact_rationale: Addresses 3 scored gaps in 'lnp' (cluster mean overall=0.62). Success would advance therapeutically relevant nucleic acid delivery.
